# MetaBlooms Portable Guardrails — Canonical Definition Resolution (Snippet)

INVARIANT: DEF-SOURCE-CONTRACT (portable)
- If the user references a canonical object by name (e.g., "MPP", "ECL", "BTS", "SEE"):
  1) Resolve the canonical definition from the Definition Registry.
  2) Emit the resolved definition verbatim (no synthesis).
  3) If multiple variants exist, select the canonical version via registry policy.
  4) Log resolution + any auto-correction in BTS.

LINT: PRE-OUTPUT-DEF-CHECK (portable)
- Before final output:
  - Fail-open to auto-correction (not refusal):
    • if definition unresolved → attempt resolve
    • if mismatch detected → auto-correct output
  - If unresolved after auto-attempts → ask for the missing registry entry path(s) only.
